i1_governing_problem_and_scale: Administration of the CBAM obligation on importers of Annex I goods into the customs territory of the Union, from admission to import (status of authorised CBAM declarant), through the declarant's declaration and surrender obligations and the certificate lifecycle, to review, determination and sanction, for the interval of the 2026-01-01 reference.
i2_coupling_description: Qualified procedural and conditional couplings between the S: (1) A16(3) sets up the registry account only when the authorisation of A17(1) is granted (authorisation -> accounts used by SC-04 and SC-05); (2) A20(1) and A23(1) address authorised CBAM declarants (authorisation -> certificate lifecycle); (3) A22(1) surrender corresponds to emissions declared under A6(2)(c) (obligation -> certificate holding), A23(1) repurchases 'excess ... after the certificates have been surrendered in accordance with Article 22' and A24 cancels remaining certificates in the registry account (surrender -> repurchase/cancellation); (4) A19(5) and A22(3) lead from findings to competent-authority decisions that require surrender (enforcement -> obligation); (5) A17(8) revokes the status on infringements of A22(1)-(2) (enforcement -> authorisation); (6) A19(6) routes excess surrender to the repurchase of A23.
i3_configurational_consequence: Differentiated allocation of decision power across the whole: information infrastructure, accounts, price, review input and preliminary calculation are concentrated at the Commission, whose outputs are stated to be indicative (A19(4)); binding status decisions, determinations of the number of certificates, penalties and the sale and repurchase of certificates are allocated to the Member States' competent authorities or to the Member State itself; the allocation is attributable to the arrangement of S, not to any single relation.
i3_bearer_and_rule: Bearer: ARCHITECTURE (ARCH-01). Rule: compare the origin positions and modalities of the binding-decision relations (QR-0006, QR-0042, QR-0052, QR-0068, QR-0055, QR-0059) with those of the Commission relations (QR-0051, QR-0035, QR-0056, QR-0062); I2 was identified from cross-references before this consequence was examined and the consequence does not presuppose integration.
i4_evidence_searched: Closure statement CL-01: every unit of W was read and screened; cross-references within W were followed; the search for qualified relations linking the S used the explicit cross-references listed under I2.
i4_rival_grouping: Rival grouping: (i) SC-01 as a separate architecture (status conferral) coupled to the rest only through the account and revocation links; (ii) SC-05 split into obligations and enforcement; (iii) SC-04 as a separate market architecture. The couplings in I2 are explicit, so none of the rivals explains the pattern without leaving the cross-references unaccounted for.
i4_boundary_sensitivity: If the external definitions (customs positions, penalty amount, price base, free-allocation extent) differ from their plain reading in W, the identity of some parties and amounts changes but not the internal procedural couplings listed under I2; the claim holds for the declared corpus only. If A16(3) and A17(8) were read as informational rather than conditional, SC-01 would decouple from the rest and the outcome would fall to OVERLAPPING_OR_PARTIALLY_INTEGRATED.
outcome_basis: I1-I4 are each stated and evidenced; no I2 coupling relation is down-coded for a constitutive external dependency. The result is provisional and holds within the declared corpus only; I2/I3 thresholds are unvalidated (queued).

i1_governing_problem_and_scale: Assurance of embedded-emission data used for declarations and surrender: accreditation of verifiers, verification of declarant and operator data, disclosure of verified operator data, and the declaration/surrender chain that uses it.
i2_coupling_description: A6(2)(b)/(d) require the declaration to contain emissions 'verified in accordance with Article 8' and copies of verification reports; A22(1) surrender corresponds to emissions 'declared ... and verified in accordance with Article 8'; A8(2) and A10(7) link operator disclosure to the declarant's verification obligation; A18(2) and Annex VI tie accreditation to the verification principles.
i3_configurational_consequence: Conditional sequence spanning functions: the number of certificates to be surrendered depends on emissions that must have passed third-party verification (A6(2)(b), A22(1), A8(1)).
i3_bearer_and_rule: Bearer: ARCHITECTURE (ARCH-02). Rule: follow the references from the surrender number (A22(1)) to the declared emissions (A6(2)(c)) to the verification condition (A8(1)).
i4_evidence_searched: Closure statement CL-01 (complete coverage of W); the status of 'accredited verifier' and of the national accreditation body is constituted by external instruments that were not retrieved.
i4_rival_grouping: Rival grouping: verification as a separate assurance architecture not coupled to the declaration/surrender chain except through the content of the declaration; the explicit A6/A22 references argue against it, but the verifier relations themselves are down-coded.
i4_boundary_sensitivity: If the external accreditation regime were assessed, the verifier and accreditation relations (QR-0010, QR-0044, QR-0013) could be raised from documented; until then the coupling through the verifier cannot be asserted for the whole.
outcome_basis: I4 is INDETERMINATE: the coupling relations that run through the accredited verifier depend constitutively on unresolved external instruments (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/2067; Regulation (EC) No 765/2008); a constitutive external dependency touching the coupling forces INDETERMINATE (RGAM-DR-25).

i1_governing_problem_and_scale: Collection, correction and enforcement of quarterly CBAM reports from importers during the transitional period 1 October 2023 to 31 December 2025.
i2_coupling_description: Within one S: A33(1) informs the importer of 'the reporting obligation referred to in Article 35'; A35(1) report to the Commission; A35(3)-(4) Commission list and indicative information to the competent authority; A35(4)-(5) correction procedure and penalty by the competent authority.
i3_configurational_consequence: Enforcement path through the Member State authority only: the Commission has information and indicative input roles and no sanctioning relation in the S.
i3_bearer_and_rule: Bearer: ARCHITECTURE (ARCH-03). Rule: compare the origin positions of the penalty and correction relations (competent authority) with those of the Commission relations (information, indicative input).
i4_evidence_searched: Closure statement CL-01; the parties 'indirect customs representative', 'customs authorities' and the customs procedures referred to are constituted by an external Regulation not retrieved; the reference date 2026-01-01 follows the end of the transitional period.
i4_rival_grouping: Rival grouping: the transitional chain as an earlier phase of ARCH-01's enforcement pattern, or as a separate architecture; the text does not couple it to ARCH-01 other than by the temporal succession of A32/A36.
i4_boundary_sensitivity: At a reference date inside the transitional period the S would be fully applicable; at 2026-01-01 only the last quarterly report (Q4 2025, due one month after quarter end) remains due.
outcome_basis: I4 is INDETERMINATE: the coupling relations depend constitutively on unresolved external customs definitions (RGAM-DR-25), and the temporal validity at the reference date is bounded.

i1_governing_problem_and_scale: Conferral and control of the Commission's delegated and implementing acts under the Regulation.
i2_coupling_description: Within one S: A28(2) conferral -> A28(5) consultation -> A28(6) notification -> A28(7) objection or A28(3) revocation; A29(1)-(2) assistance by the CBAM Committee under the examination procedure referred to in each implementing-act empowerment.
i3_configurational_consequence: Plural checks on secondary rule-making: for delegated acts each of the European Parliament and the Council can block entry into force or revoke the delegation; for implementing acts a committee of Member State representatives assists.
i3_bearer_and_rule: Bearer: ARCHITECTURE (ARCH-04). Rule: list the holders of block/revoke powers in the QR set.
i4_evidence_searched: Closure statement CL-01; the effect of the CBAM Committee's involvement (examination procedure) is defined by Regulation (EU) No 182/2011, which was not retrieved.
i4_rival_grouping: Rival grouping: delegated acts (A28) and implementing acts (A29) as two architectures; the shared Commission function and the A28(2)/A29(2) cross-references do not decide between them.
i4_boundary_sensitivity: If the external examination procedure gives the committee a binding control over the Commission's draft acts, the S would carry a further check; if it gives only a consultative role, only the delegated-act checks remain.
outcome_basis: I4 is INDETERMINATE: the committee relation (QR-0082) depends constitutively on an unresolved external Regulation (RGAM-DR-25).

i1_governing_problem_and_scale: Maintenance of the third-country scope boundary and the conditional electricity exemption (A2(6)-(12), Annex III).
i2_coupling_description: Within one S: the exemption of A2(7) is conditioned on the Commission's assessment 'in accordance with paragraph 8'; the third country reports to the Commission and the Commission assesses (A2(8)); removal follows A2(9); list amendment by delegated act depends on whether the conditions of paragraphs 6, 7 or 9 are fulfilled (A2(11)).
i3_configurational_consequence: Conditional exemption sequence: exemption (A2(7)) holds only while reporting and Commission assessment support it, and its loss triggers the requirements of A2(10); the property belongs to the whole, not to a single relation.
i3_bearer_and_rule: Bearer: ARCHITECTURE (ARCH-05). Rule: follow the conditions of A2(7) to the reporting and assessment relations to the removal conditions of A2(9).
i4_evidence_searched: Closure statement CL-01. The relation QR-0004, which depends constitutively on the external market-coupling Regulation, was left out of the I2 coupling set and is flagged; no listed third country is evidenced (point 2 of Annex III is a placeholder).
i4_rival_grouping: Rival grouping: the list-amendment power (A2(11)) belongs to the delegation pattern only. The conditions and the reporting/assessment relations are specific to the scope pattern.
i4_boundary_sensitivity: If QR-0004 were included in the coupling set, the I4 status would become INDETERMINATE because it depends constitutively on the external Regulation (EU) 2015/1222; the sequence of reporting, assessment and removal does not depend on it.
outcome_basis: I1-I4 are each stated and evidenced within the declared corpus; the arrangement is a norm only (no third country listed in point 2 of Annex III is evidenced). The result is provisional; I2/I3 thresholds are unvalidated (queued).

i1_governing_problem_and_scale: Notification and investigation of circumvention practices (A27).
i2_coupling_description: Within one S: A27(4) notification by a Member State, an affected or benefited party or an interested party; A27(5) initiation and conduct of an investigation by the Commission, assisted by and notifying competent authorities.
i3_configurational_consequence: No configurational consequence is stated: the text does not say what follows an investigation (A27(5) states only that it is concluded within nine months); the delegated-act power of A27(6) is not tied to the investigation outcome.
i3_bearer_and_rule: Bearer would be the S; no property attributable to the whole beyond the sum of the relations has been identified.
i4_evidence_searched: Closure statement CL-01; the consequence of an investigation is not stated anywhere in W, so its absence is a statement about the declared corpus only.
i4_rival_grouping: Rival grouping: include A27(6) as the consequence of the investigation; the text does not tie them.
i4_boundary_sensitivity: If the delegated act of A27(6) were read as the consequence of an investigation, I3 could be satisfied; the text does not support that reading.
outcome_basis: I3 is INDETERMINATE: no property attributable to the whole is evidenced beyond the notification and initiation relations; the S stays at S.

i1_governing_problem_and_scale: The Regulation as one governance arrangement serving the object stated in Article 1(1): addressing greenhouse gas emissions embedded in Annex I goods on importation, to prevent carbon leakage.
i2_coupling_description: Explicit couplings exist among SC-01, SC-04 and SC-05 (see ARCH-01) and, through the verification condition, to SC-03 and SC-02 (see ARCH-02, indeterminate). SC-08 is coupled to the other S only through the empowerment assignments (A28(2), A29(2)) that refer to provisions of those S; SC-09 is coupled through the scope of the Regulation (A2(4), A2(7)) and through delegated acts; SC-07 is separated in time (A32, A36) and not coupled to the definitive-period S by a qualified relation; SC-10 and SC-11 are not coupled to the others by qualified relations.
i3_configurational_consequence: A single configurational property of the whole instrument is not warranted: the integrated core (ARCH-01) coexists with S that are coupled by distributed powers only (empowerments) or not at all (transitional, circumvention, reports).
i3_bearer_and_rule: Bearer: ARCHITECTURE (ARCH-07). Rule: the coupling kinds of I2 are not an ordered scale; no union of S is taken as warrant.
i4_evidence_searched: Closure statement CL-01 and CL-07 (absence of a qualified relation coupling the transitional regime to the definitive regime, within the declared corpus only); unresolved external constitutive dependencies are listed for the S concerned.
i4_rival_grouping: Rival grouping: one architecture for the whole Regulation; or distinguishable architectures (compliance regime, transitional regime, delegation, scope management). Declared coverage is complete for W, but unresolved constitutive external dependencies prevent a 'distinct architectures' outcome (RGAM-DR-25), and the empowerment couplings are source-supported overlaps.
i4_boundary_sensitivity: If the external instruments were resolved, the verification and delegation S could be integrated into the core, and the transitional regime could be recognised as a separate (distinguishable) architecture; as it stands the whole is partially integrated.
outcome_basis: Overlap is source-supported: the integrated core (ARCH-01) overlaps with the delegation S (empowerment assignments referring to its provisions) and with the verification and operator S (through the verification condition); the intersection is not treated as a new architecture; other S remain unintegrated or indeterminate. The outcome is queued for human review.
